gaps: QUEUE_MIRROR_POST_WRITE_BLOB_REVERIFY_GAP

Queue mirror compares an existing destination with the remote tree OID, but after git-show text capture and UTF-8 write it does not recompute and require the resulting blob OID to equal the listed remote blob.
Read blob bytes without text conversion and verify the final staged mirror file against the exact remote object ID.
QUEUE_MIRROR_REPARSE_CONTAINMENT_GAP
Mirror containment uses GetFullPath string-prefix checks only; it does not resolve handles, volume identity, junctions or reparse points.
Resolve the opened directory/file handle to its final volume path and reject any reparse traversal outside the approved work root.
QUEUE_MIRROR_REPLACEMENT_CRASH_WINDOW_GAP
The current mirror directory is recursively removed before the temporary mirror is moved into place.
Use a versioned generation directory plus one atomically switched pointer; never delete the only readable mirror first.
QUEUE_MIRROR_TEMP_NAMESPACE_PID_REUSE_GAP
The temporary mirror name is based only on the process ID and an existing path is recursively deleted, so PID reuse or leftover reparse state can target an unrelated generation.
Use a random run nonce, exclusive directory creation and final-handle containment before any cleanup.
QUEUE_MIRROR_OBJECT_FORMAT_ASSUMPTION_GAP
Queue enumeration requires exactly 40 hexadecimal object IDs and the local blob verifier is hard-coded to SHA-1.
Read extensions.objectFormat and parse/verify the repository's declared object-ID format, including SHA-256 repositories.
QUEUE_MIRROR_UNBOUNDED_ENTRY_SIZE_COUNT_GAP
The runner lists the full status tree and materializes every matching queue file without an explicit count, individual-size or total-byte ceiling.
Apply bounded entry count, path length, per-blob bytes and aggregate mirror-size limits before writing.
QUEUE_JSON_DUPLICATE_KEY_LAST_WINS_GAP
Read-JsonFile uses ConvertFrom-Json; Microsoft documents that duplicate JSON keys collapse and only the last key is retained.
Reject duplicate and case-colliding keys with a strict streaming parser before schema validation.
QUEUE_SAFETY_BOOLEAN_COERCION_GAP
Safety flags accept strings such as 1, yes and y and can infer safety from loosely typed nested fields.
Require actual JSON booleans at one canonical schema location and reject aliases or coercion.
ALLOWED_PATH_CASE_UNICODE_NORMALIZATION_GAP
Allowed-path comparisons use textual equality/prefix rules without a canonical case, Unicode normalization or volume comparison policy.
Normalize Git paths and resolved Windows paths under an explicit ordinal policy and reject collisions.
ALLOWED_PATH_REPARSE_ESCAPE_GAP
Staging validates Git path names but not the final filesystem target reached through symlinks, junctions or reparse points.
Open every candidate path safely and prove its final handle remains within an exact authorized root before write and stage.
STAGE_PREEXISTING_INDEX_CONTAMINATION_GAP
Stage-AllowedOnly adds allowed paths but does not first prove that the task worktree index is empty and generation-owned.
Start from a clean isolated index, record the pre-stage tree/index hash and reject any inherited staged entry.
CLAIM_LOCAL_CAS_REMOTE_RACE_GAP
Write-ClaimCas compares and updates a worktree file locally; separate worktrees can both pass local CAS before either remote push is observed.
Use an authoritative remote ref/lease transaction with an expected old value, or a single external CAS store.
CLAIM_IDENTITY_CONTINUATION_ATTEMPT_GAP
Running, terminal and done claim payloads shown in the runner omit the canonical continuation_key and attempt_id identity tuple.
Bind slot, task, attempt, continuation, source queue blob, run nonce and runner instance in every claim transition.
CLAIM_CONFLICT_RESTORE_OVERWRITE_GAP
If the claim file changes during automation, the runner writes the prior runningPayload back to the claim path before blocking.
Never overwrite an unexpected claim; quarantine both versions and fail closed with a conflict receipt.
CURRENT_TASK_CHANGE_DISCARD_EVIDENCE_GAP
An unexpected current-task change is reverted with checkout from HEAD, discarding the changed bytes before preserving a forensic receipt.
Hash and quarantine unexpected bytes, record the writer/generation if available, then restore only after evidence publication.
SUCCESS_GATE_FIELDS_NOT_ENFORCED_GAP
After a zero automation exit, the runner parses or creates a gate object but the observed success path does not require its pass fields before push and done claim.
Define exact required gate fields and values and fail closed unless all are true and bound to the current generation.
GATE_PARSE_FAILURE_ZERO_EXIT_CONTINUATION_GAP
A gate parse failure records a blocker and writes a default fail-closed gate, but automationCode can remain zero and continue into the completion path.
Set a non-zero terminal code on parse/default-gate creation and prohibit completion.
CONTROLLER_QUEUE_BLOCKED_WRITE_NOT_PUBLISHED_GAP
The outer task exception handler writes blocked status directly to the controller queue file but does not commit and push that change.
Publish a generation-bound blocked receipt through the same remote optimistic-lock path or leave the remote queue untouched with an external error receipt.
SCAN_STATUS_DIRECT_NONATOMIC_PUBLICATION_GAP
Selection, skip, latest-status, report and runner-heartbeat files use direct WriteAllText paths rather than strict durable atomic publication.
Use strict schema-bound JSON, unique temporary files, flush and atomic replacement for every control record.
REMOTE_QUEUE_COMMIT_REVALIDATION_BEFORE_CLAIM_GAP
The queue mirror records one remote commit, but the remote branch and task blob are not revalidated immediately before acknowledgement and claim push.
Re-fetch and require the exact remote queue commit/task blob immediately before the claim transaction.
PUSH_MULTI_FILE_TRANSACTION_ATOMICITY_GAP
Claim, current task, heartbeat, queue, gate and output files are staged and pushed in several phases without one manifest proving the complete state transition.
Publish one generation manifest that hashes every child and atomically advances one branch/ref from an expected old commit.
QUEUE_MIRROR_UTF8_ROUNDTRIP_BYTE_IDENTITY_GAP
git-show output is captured as PowerShell text and rewritten as UTF-8, although Git blob content is an uninterpreted byte sequence.
Use binary-safe cat-file/blob streaming and preserve exact bytes, line endings and encoding.
